b: Link kholein: https://aemporio6.github.io/nexus-sourcing/
"Sign in with Google" dabayein — apni wahi Google email jo Admin ne Setup mein dali hai.
"Google hasn't verified this app" aaye to Advanced → Go to … → Continue.
Phone pe: Android ⋮ → Add to Home screen · iPhone Share → Add to Home Screen.
Upar: Home · Back · Forward · Search (Ctrl K) · Undo · Redo · Refresh · Recent (ghari) · Alerts (ghanti) · + Create.
Baayein (phone pe neeche): Home, Purchases, Shipments, Payments, Stock; More mein Products, Parties, Planner (ICC), Import, Reports, Setup.
Har order pe "👉 Next step" likha hota hai — wahi agla kaam hai, button dabayein.
Har number ke saath ⓘ How — dabane se pata chalta hai hisab kaise bana.
Har record (order, shipment, payment, product, party) ke upar "👉 Next step" — agla kaam aur us ka button.
Record khula ho to upar "‹ Prev / Next ›" (ya Alt ↑ / Alt ↓) se list ka pichla/agla record — band kiye baghair.
Filter dropdown mein "＋ Choose several…" — kai supplier / status ek saath tick karein.
Naye form mein aam values pehle se bhari hoti hain (RMB, China, pack, WAL…). Badalni hon to Setup › Lists mein "Default" chunein.
Naya order: + Create → Purchase. Supplier, lines, PI number aur PI link zaroor.
Payment: order kholein → Pay. Ek payment kai cheezon ki ho (jaise ¥22,217 mein sample, inspection) to "Split the extra" se har hissa alag likhein.
Shipment: order pe "Record shipment" → cartons, kg, forwarder, mode, UK arrival port. Pahunche to "Receive".
Receipt / invoice: record ke Docs mein link ya file lagayein. Bina receipt payment Alerts mein aati hai.
Order form mein "PI billed to" — PI kis company ke naam pe hai. Kisi aur company ke naam pe ho to Alert aata hai — supplier se Vartleaves ke naam pe reissue karwayein (import VAT ke liye).
More → Import → file chunein ya "From Google Drive" se folder/files chunein.
App khud pehchanti hai: Joyce CI, packing sheet, Shunqi PDF, Eco PI, Amazon/eBay/Temu reports.
Save se pehle total check: file total = import total ✅. Farq ho to wajah likh kar hi save hoga.
Faltu columns side panel mein: Keep / Skip. Same file dobara daali to "already in the app".
Drive mein "MY TOOL – INBOX" naam ka folder bana kar files daalein — app khud batayegi ke nayi files aayi hain.
More → Planner (ICC): product(s) chunein ya naya product likhein.
Sales/month, lead-time stages, cycle length dropdown se. Size/gift box/carton product se khud aata hai.
Result: reorder kab aur kitna, dates 🟢🟡🟠🔴, freight, 30/50/20 cash plan → "Create purchase order". Plan save / delete bhi.
Reports / Payments page pe "⬇ Payment Summary" — Excel bilkul purani Payment Summary ke style mein.
Sirf Setup › Users mein dali emails khol sakti hain; Admin "Share data" se Drive folder share karta hai. Nayi email Google Cloud › Audience › Test users mein bhi dalni hai.
Data aemporio6 ki Drive mein "MY TOOL – DATA" folder mein; roz ek backup copy khud banti hai.
Owner: menu mein ⬇ Backup aur ⬆ Load data file. Kuch delete nahi hota — Trash se wapas aa jata hai.
Kisi ko hatana ho: Setup › Users mein Active ka tick hatayein. Wahan har user ka Department bhi.
Setup › Companies mein Company number (Companies House), VAT, EORI.
More → Help / guide: yahi guide app ke andar, English aur Roman Urdu dono.
Menu mein "● Live / Saving…" dekhein. "Signed out" ho to us pe dabayein aur dobara sign in karein.
Internet na ho to kaam device pe save rehta hai, net aate hi Drive mein chala jata hai.
Screenshot le kar Admin ko bhejein.
More → Data health: 27 asool ka check (raqam, dates, links, stock, duplicate). % score, aur har masle ke saath Open / Fix button. Sangeen masle Alerts mein bhi aate hain.
Do log ek hi record ek waqt mein badlein: dono ki tabdeeli jud jati hai. Ek hi field dono ne badla ho to baad wali value rehti hai aur Alerts mein "Checked ✓" ke liye aata hai.
Do logon ne ek saath naya order banaya aur number ek hi aa gaya: ek ka number khud agla ho jata hai, us ki payment bhi saath badal jati hai.
Ghalat cheez save hi nahi hoti: ghalat date, khali/minus raqam, payment se zyada split.
Period lock (Data health): VAT quarter file hone ke baad us date tak ke records band. Owner "Unlock for this session" se khol sakta hai.
Version history (Data health): roz ki backup list → "Go back to this day". Pehle aaj ki copy khud save hoti hai.
Exchange rate roz khud online aata hai (European Central Bank). Haath se badla hua rate kabhi overwrite nahi hota.
App errors: kisi ki screen pe koi ghalti aaye to Data health mein likhi jati hai.
Baayein menu Seller Central jaisa: har module (Purchases, Shipments, Payments…) ke neeche us ke hisse (Still to pay, On the way, Pending…). ▸ dabane se kisi bhi module ke hisse khulte hain.
"☰ All menus" — saare modules aur un ke hisse ek hi screen pe (phone pe More).
Naye tab / window mein kholna: Ctrl (Mac pe ⌘) + click, mouse ka beech wala button, ya right-click → Open in new tab. Khule record pe "↗ New window".
Address bar mein hamesha wahi jagah likhi hoti hai (jaise #/purchases?owing=1) — copy karke kisi ko bhej sakte hain ya bookmark bana sakte hain.
Home pe "Work in order": order → deposit → production → inspection → balance → ship → receive → reorder. Har qadam pe kitne kaam baqi hain; dabane se wahi list khulti hai.
Product kholein: "📦 Packing (worked out)" — sirf product ka size/weight, packing ke saath size/weight, master carton, per carton, net/gross weight, CBM — sab khud hisab.
Order kholein: "📦 Packing" — har line ke full cartons, tail carton (jaise 950 pcs @100 = 9 full + 1 tail carton 50 pcs), gross weight, CBM aur total.
"💷 Landing cost per pack": buying + China fee + shipping + UK/duty/VAT = landed. Har order ka alag, average, aur sell price se margin.
"🏷️ Batches": har aaye maal ka batch — supplier ka batch no. dalein, warna MY TOOL khud banata hai (SKU-YYMM-n). Har batch ki qty, bacha hua aur landed cost.
Products → "📄 Product info sheet": supplier ki product information sheet chunein — sizes, weight, carton, HS code, material, link khud bhar jate hain (pehle dikhata hai kya badlega).
Order pe "⬇ Product info sheet": isi format mein Excel khud ban jati hai (qty, cartons, weight, CBM ke saath).
Payment mein "+ Several orders / shipments…": kai orders ek payment mein, har ek ki alag raqam.
"+ Create" aur har module ka "+ New…" ek hi list se bante hain — jo yahan, wahi wahan.

Data gateway (Setup › Users): ON ho to har read/save owner ke Google account script se jaata hai. Roles data par check hote hain: VA sirf create, Finance edit magar Setup nahi, bank details sirf 'bank' wale role ko. Kisi ko Drive access nahi chahiye. Admin ek dafa 'Lock data folder' dabaye.
Sync ka haal (upar): Synced · Syncing… · device par mehfooz, internet ka intezar · fail, N sec mein dobara · N conflicts to check.
Conflict: do logon ne ek hi waqt ek hi field badli → Alerts mein dono values; 'Use theirs' doosre ki value leta hai (log hota hai), 'Keep all ✓' jo dikh raha hai wahi rakhta hai.
Trash guard: jis record par payments / shipments / receipts depend karte hon, Trash se pehle list dikhti hai; faisla aap ka.
Har order par 'Does it add up?': PI total vs lines + fee + extras · paid + credits + balance vs total · ordered vs shipped vs received. Laal row = theek karna hai.
'Changed by hand': AUTO value jo aap ne badli — auto value, kis ne, kab — record par nazar aata hai.
Save & add another: naye form par save kar ke agla form wahi party / kind / company ke saath kholta hai.
Import › ⬇ Row report: har row ka status aur wajah (CSV); Import button batata hai kitni rows reh gayin aur kyun.
Backups: roz raat copy (Apps Script, app band ho tab bhi) + admin ke istemal ke dauran usi din ki copy. Data health › Version history mein dono; restore se pehle 'before-restore' copy banti hai.
Attachments: zyada se zyada 20 MB; PDF, images, Excel, Word, CSV, ZIP. Upload fail ho to wajah dikhti hai, dobara koshish — kuch adhoora save nahi hota.
Nayi version aaye to khuli tab mein 'New version ready — Reload' aata hai.

Yearly archive (Setup › Backup): guzre saal ke band records MYTOOL-ARCHIVE-YYYY.json mein chale jaate hain (read-only, 'Archived' badge ke saath nazar aate hain). Live file hamesha chhoti rehti hai. 'Bring back YYYY' se wapas edit ho sakte hain.
Mahine ki Transaction report download karein (Seller Hub › Payments › Reports › Transaction report › CSV). Order report mein fees nahi hotin — paison ke liye wo na lein.
Import karein (Data › Import): MY TOOL pehchan leta hai, eBay account ka naam poochta hai (jaise TOUQEER), aur totals dikhata hai: sales, eBay fees, promoted, insertion, refunds, net.
Har fee apne order aur SKU se judti hai. Promoted Listings order number se; kai products wale order mein item value ke hisab se taqseem; pichhle mahine ke orders ki fees account level par.
US / EU site ki rows us row ke apne exchange rate se £ mein; site UK / US / EU dikhti hai.
Marketplace P&L page: account aur mahine ke hisab se, aur SKU ke hisab se — landed cost per pack aap ke orders se → profit = net − landed × units.
Sirf summaries save hoti hain (account × SKU × period), data file chhoti rehti hai; Row report CSV mein poori detail.
Pichhla mahina bhi import karein taake late promotion fees apne order se mil jayen. Subscription aur insertion account ka kharcha hain, SKU ka nahi.

en.h: 10. Keeping the data safe and correct
b: More → Data health: 27 rules checked (money, dates, links, stock, duplicates). A % score, and Open / Fix on every issue. Serious ones also go to Alerts.
Two people change the same record at the same time: both changes are kept. If both changed the same field, the later value stays and Alerts asks someone to tick "Checked ✓".
Two people create a new order at the same moment and get the same number: one is renumbered automatically, and its payment follows it.
Wrong data is never saved: impossible dates, empty/negative paid amounts, a split bigger than the payment.
Period lock (Data health): after a VAT quarter is filed, records up to that date are closed. The owner can "Unlock for this session".
Version history (Data health): the daily backups → "Go back to this day". A copy of today is saved first.
Exchange rates come in by themselves every day (European Central Bank). A rate typed by hand is never overwritten.
App errors: any error on anyone's screen is written down in Data health.

en.h: 11. Menu and the order of work
b: The left menu works like Seller Central: each module (Purchases, Shipments, Payments…) lists its parts (Still to pay, On the way, Pending…). Tap ▸ to open any module's parts.
"☰ All menus" — every module and part on one screen (on a phone: More).
Open in a new tab / window: Ctrl (⌘ on Mac) + click, middle mouse button, or right-click → Open in new tab. An open record has "↗ New window".
The address bar always shows where you are (e.g. #/purchases?owing=1) — copy it to send to someone or bookmark it.
Home shows "Work in order": order → deposit → production → inspection → balance → ship → receive → reorder. Each step shows how many are waiting; tap it to open that list.
Open a product: "📦 Packing (worked out)" — product-only size/weight, size/weight with packaging, master carton, per carton, net/gross weight, CBM — all calculated.
Open an order: "📦 Packing" — full cartons per line, the tail carton (e.g. 950 pcs at 100 = 9 full + 1 tail carton of 50), gross weight, CBM and totals.
"💷 Landing cost per pack": buying + China fee + shipping + UK/duty/VAT = landed. Per order, the average, and the margin against the sell price.
"🏷️ Batches": every delivery is a batch — type the supplier's batch no., or MY TOOL numbers it (SKU-YYMM-n). Qty, left and landed cost per batch.
Products → "📄 Product info sheet": pick a supplier's product information sheet — sizes, weights, cartons, HS code, material and link are filled in (it shows what will change first).
On an order "⬇ Product info sheet": the same Excel layout is made for you (qty, cartons, weight, CBM).
In a payment "+ Several orders / shipments…": one payment over many orders, each with its own amount.
"+ Create" and each module's "+ New…" come from one list — what is in one is in the other.

Data gateway (Setup › Users): with it ON, every read and save goes through the owner's Google account script. Roles are checked at the data itself: VA = create only, Finance = edit but no Setup, bank details only for roles with 'bank'. Nobody needs Drive access. Admin: 'Lock data folder' once.
Sync state (top bar): Synced · Syncing… · Saved on this device — waiting for internet · Save failed — retrying in N s · N conflicts to check.
Conflict: two people changed the same field at the same moment → Alerts shows both values; 'Use theirs' takes the other value (logged), 'Keep all ✓' keeps what is shown.
Trash guard: a record that payments, shipments or receipts still point to is listed before it goes to Trash; you decide.
'Does it add up?' on every order: PI total vs lines + fee + extras · paid + credits + balance vs total · ordered vs shipped vs received. Red row = something to fix.
'Changed by hand' on a record: an AUTO value you replaced — the automatic value, who and when stay visible.
Save & add another: on a new form, saves and opens the next one with the same party / kind / company.
Import › ⬇ Row report: every row with status and reason (CSV); the Import button says how many rows are left out and why.

Backups: a copy every night (Apps Script, even when nobody opens the app) + a same-day copy while an admin uses the app. Data health › Version history lists both; restore makes a 'before-restore' copy first.
Attachments: max 20 MB; PDF, images, Excel, Word, CSV, ZIP. If an upload fails you see why and can try again — nothing is saved half-done.
New version: when MY TOOL is updated, an open tab shows 'New version ready — Reload'.

Yearly archive (Setup › Backup): closed records of a past year move to MYTOOL-ARCHIVE-YYYY.json (read-only, still visible with an 'Archived' badge). The live file stays small for ever. 'Bring back YYYY' makes them editable again.
Download the Transaction report (Seller Hub › Payments › Reports › Transaction report › CSV) for a month. The Order report has no fees — don't use it for money.
Import it (Data › Import): MY TOOL recognises it, asks the eBay account name (e.g. TOUQEER), and shows the totals: sales, eBay fees, promoted listings, insertion, refunds, net.

Every fee is linked to its order and SKU (custom label). Promoted Listings fees follow the order number; multi-product orders split by item value; fees for last month's orders are counted at account level.
Foreign sites (eBay US, EU) are converted at the row's own exchange rate; the site is shown as UK / US / EU.
Marketplace P&L page: by account and month, and by SKU with landed cost per pack from your orders → profit = net − landed × units.
Only the summaries are stored (one per account × SKU × period) so the data file stays small; the Row report CSV keeps the per-row detail.
Import the previous month too so late promotion fees find their orders. Subscription and insertion are account costs, not per SKU.
